patch.value: Verify and complete empty Unreleased suppression for issue 337

Track issue 337: include-empty retains versioned release sections only; never render an empty Unreleased section in replace, prepend, stdout, or check. Verify real pending-write, commit, tag, post-tag-check sequences and retain nonempty notes. Related earlier work: pmc-stable-itemless-check; this item owns the exact issue 337 regression proof and remaining mode gaps.
